blockers.description: Official document bodies and per-page content hashes are not retained, so provider-required subjects remain blocked.
Generated documentation and API build closure have not been deterministically replayed.

limitations: This metadata inventory proves the bounded exact tree and path universe only; it does not prove rendered documentation completeness or provider behavior.

External raw identity is the SHA-256 of canonical sorted git ls-tree -r receipt lines '<mode> <object_type> <object_id>\t<path>\n' for every inventory entry; the local inventory JSON is metadata evidence only and contains no official document body bytes.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.

document-bodies-not-retained.description: Only exact Git object and path metadata are retained; official document body bytes remain external.

rendered-build-not-replayed.description: The exact documentation build, generated API surfaces, and asset transformations have not been replayed.
